slot_scores.name: earnings_definition
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the goal to maximize the total wealth (principal plus returns) at the end of the three-year horizon?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether the objective is to maximize total wealth including principal and returns at the end of year 3, which resolves the meaning of 'earnings' as final wealth rather than net profit.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only hidden slot was P2, and it was explicitly asked and resolved before READY_TO_MODEL. No P0 or P1 hidden slots were left unresolved.

summary: The agent clarified the objective definition and several relevant modeling details before stopping. The sole hidden slot H1 was covered directly, so the interaction is appropriate for this case.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
